title: Immunohistochemistry protocol for γH2AX detection \(formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded sections)
protocol: Deparaffinize tissue sections in Histolemon for 10 minutes twice.
Hydrate tissue sections through a graded alcohol series (100%, 95%, 70%) for 5 minutes once.
Incubate the slides in EDTA for 50 minutes at 95°C for antigen unmasking.
Cool the slides for 20 minutes at room temperature, then wash once in water.
Incubate the slides in 3% hydrogen peroxide for 5 minutes at room temperature to quench endogenous peroxidases.
Wash the slides twice in TBS.
Preincubate the slides with antibody mix for 20 minutes at room temperature.
Incubate the slides overnight at 4°C with anti-γH2AX diluted in antibody mix at the indicated concentration, then wash twice in TBS.
Incubate the slides with secondary antibody for 30 minutes at room temperature, then wash twice in TBS.
Incubate the slides in peroxidase substrate solution for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Block the reaction in water, counterstain with hematoxylin for 15 seconds, and wash the slides in running water.
Dehydrate tissue sections through a graded alcohol series and mount with Eukitt.
